selection_basis: RCSB entry and polymer-entity metadata, before computing study measurements. The two distinct depositions contain entity 1 in asymmetric-unit label chains A, B and C; both are X-ray entries of TL1A without another polymer entity. One original paper reports both entries. Their different resolutions, 2.1 and 3.0 angstroms, describe refinement and do not establish independent biological sampling.
geometry_scope: Within-deposition model 1, entity 1, common label_seq_id, residue and atom name across A/B/C. Compare mask sensitivity within each deposition before comparing the two conclusions. Absolute chain-to-chain angles depend on crystal geometry. No functional, binding or solution-state inference.
